summary: A delegate leaves with the remarks they came to make still in their pocket.
realLife: Harrington said a lawyer encouraged him and Chapman during recess to address the convention, but voting was still underway when they left late that afternoon.
gates: Someone has invited a delegate to speak without reserving time.
inGame: needs: a proposed speaking opportunity and the times the member left and voting ended.

turns.what: The delegate gets part of the remarks on the record.
turns.pulledBy: The chair inserts a short break between ballots.
turns.writesBack: The minutes identify what the room actually heard.

turns.what: The secretary attaches them to the correspondence.
turns.pulledBy: The delegate sends the remarks to the secretary after leaving.
turns.writesBack: The written submission has a receipt separate from the proceedings.
